segments.sn35.9:1.3: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ cakkhusmiṃ anapekkho hoti;
segments.sn35.9:1.5: paccuppannassa cakkhussa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
segments.sn35.9:1.6: Sotaṃ anattā … pe … ghānaṃ anattā … pe … jivhā anattā atītānāgatā;
segments.sn35.9:1.10: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītāya jivhāya anapekkho hoti;
segments.sn35.9:1.12: paccuppannāya jivhāya nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
segments.sn35.9:1.13: Kāyo anattā … pe … mano anattā atītānāgato;
segments.sn35.9:1.16: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ manasmiṃ anapekkho hoti;
segments.sn35.9:1.18: paccuppannassa manassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hotī”ti.
